rules.title: H.3744 home rule petition authorizing Boston rent stabilization (not enacted)
rules.requirement: This bill would have let Boston adopt rent stabilization, but it was sent to a study order in September 2024 and the 2023-2024 session ended. It does not limit your rent increases.

coverage.summary: Proposed authorization for rent stabilization in the City of Boston; the page does not show bill text or coverage details.

rules.quoted_span: that the city of Boston be authorized to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections.
rules.interaction: Home rule petition seeking state legislative authorization for Boston to implement rent stabilization. Massachusetts state law otherwise bars local rent control.

rules.title: H.3744 home rule petition authorizing Boston tenant eviction protections (not enacted)
rules.requirement: This bill would have let Boston adopt tenant eviction protections, but it was sent to a study order in September 2024 and was not enacted. It gives you no just-cause eviction rights.

coverage.summary: Proposed authorization for tenant eviction protections in the City of Boston; the page does not show bill text or coverage details.

rules.quoted_span: that the city of Boston be authorized to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections.

notes: The document is only a bill-status page for H.3744. It contains no bill text, so it gives no caps, causes, coverage or dates. The bill accompanied a study order (H5035) on 9/9/2024, which effectively ends it, and the 193rd session has ended, so both records are marked failed. Statewide rent control preemption is not stated in this document.
